evals.prompt: Archive the remaining sample capstone papers from Sample papers/ground_truth_manifest.json by interacting with the CMS-V2 browser UI for each file, verify legacy .doc rejection, and confirm ChromaDB indexes the newly archived papers.
evals.expected_output: Runs edge-case and sliced Playwright browser archival batches against /archive/upload/capstone using scripts/browser_batch_archive.mjs, validates BSEMC/BSIT academic programs, handles 40MB+ PDFs and DOCX manuscripts without timeouts or Multer field errors, verifies ChromaDB collection_count > 0, and inspects /archive visually.
expectations: Paginated GET /api/projects/archive/search with limit <= 50 is used before uploading so already-archived titles are skipped cleanly.
waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' is used instead of 'networkidle' and batches stay <= 10 papers per run with a <120s watchdog.
Legacy .doc rejection is tested explicitly via UI toast without crashing the batch.
ChromaDB /health collection_count > 0 and live /archive viewer rendering are verified after ingestion.

Checks plagiarism_engine/plagiarism_engine/main.py _run_inprocess_index uses IndexRequest(...) and embeddings.py clamps max_seq_length to model positional embeddings.
Re-tests the fix via live browser upload and inspects container logs.

evals.prompt: Batch ingest 25 newly collected BSIT and BSEMC capstone PDF/DOCX manuscripts into CMS-V2 through the browser UI using a manifest JSON and verify they appear under their respective program filters in /archive.
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight checks for missing Academic Program nodes, executes scripts/browser_batch_archive.mjs in 10-paper slices with incremental JSON checkpointing, and verifies program filters plus PDF/DOCX document rendering in /archive.
expectations: Verifies or creates BSIT and BSEMC courses via /api/academics/courses before starting batch uploads.
Saves incremental results after each uploaded manuscript.
Confirms PDF and DOCX documents render cleanly inside SophisticatedDocumentViewer.
